title: 2061. Hashing Without Collision

Hashing Without Collision
30

Problem Statement
Given a hash table of size m and n keys, insert the keys into the hash table using the hash function:
h(key) = key % m
It is guaranteed that no collisions will occur.
Print the final hash table. Empty positions should contain -1.
Input Format
First line contains two integers m and n.
Second line contains n space-separated integers representing the keys.
Output Format
Print the hash table elements separated by spaces.
Constraints
1 ≤ m ≤ 100
1 ≤ n ≤ m
Sample Input
10 5
12 25 36 47 58
Sample Output
-1 -1 12 -1 -1 25 36 47 58 -1
